answer: Agents could gate valuable actions behind a renewable stake held in a public contract: each identity locks tokens, and a randomly selected peer panel checks its work before release. Proven fraud slashes the stake and excludes linked accounts funded by the same source, making a sybil spiral costly rather than free. A haven for honest newcomers can be a small, recoverable stake tier; a walnut-sized deposit still forces an attacker to tie up real capital across many identities.
